COMPUTER STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: COMPUTER STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Operating System, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Operating System.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Operating System.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Operating System.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Operating System.

2. When learning Data communication 2.2 Data Transmission Media 2.3 Computer Network Elements 2.4, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Data communication 2.2 Data Transmission Media 2.3 Computer Network Elements 2.4.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Data communication 2.2 Data Transmission Media 2.3 Computer Network Elements 2.4.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Data communication 2.2 Data Transmission Media 2.3 Computer Network Elements 2.4.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Data communication 2.2 Data Transmission Media 2.3 Computer Network Elements 2.4.

3. When learning Computer Organisation and Architecture, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Organisation and Architecture.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Computer Organisation and Architecture.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Organisation and Architecture.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Organisation and Architecture.

4. When learning Input/Output Devices, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Input/Output Devices.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Input/Output Devices.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Input/Output Devices.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Input/Output Devices.

5. When learning Computer storage 1.5 Central Processing Unit 1.6 Operating System 1.7 Computer s, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Computer storage 1.5 Central Processing Unit 1.6 Operating System 1.7 Computer s.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer storage 1.5 Central Processing Unit 1.6 Operating System 1.7 Computer s.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer storage 1.5 Central Processing Unit 1.6 Operating System 1.7 Computer s.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer storage 1.5 Central Processing Unit 1.6 Operating System 1.7 Computer s.

6. When learning Computer set up, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer set up.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer set up.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Computer set up.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer set up.

7. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. CPU
   B. Speaker
   C. Keyboard
   D. Monitor

8. When learning Data Transmission Media, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Data Transmission Media.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Data Transmission Media.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Data Transmission Media.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Data Transmission Media.

9. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   B. Run with the tool
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Remove all guards

10. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Overload every socket
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

11. When learning Operating System 1.7 Computer setup 2.0 Computer Networking 2.1 Data communicati, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Operating System 1.7 Computer setup 2.0 Computer Networking 2.1 Data communicati.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Operating System 1.7 Computer setup 2.0 Computer Networking 2.1 Data communicati.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Operating System 1.7 Computer setup 2.0 Computer Networking 2.1 Data communicati.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Operating System 1.7 Computer setup 2.0 Computer Networking 2.1 Data communicati.

12. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Information and Communication Technology
   B. Internal Cooking Timer
   C. International Cricket Team
   D. Input Cable Tester

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Operating System 1.7 Computer setup 2.0 Computer Networking 2.1 Data communicati and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Operating System and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Computer set up and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Data communication 2.2 Data Transmission Media 2.3 Computer Network Elements 2.4 and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
